name: Aquarius-Governance-Agent
description: Autonomous agent specialized in DAO governance. Creates, analyzes, and manages proposals. Ensures alignment with Aquarius principles of hybrid human-AI collaboration. Uses reputation-weighted voting logic.

mcpEndpoints.name: createProposal
mcpEndpoints.description: Creates a new DAO proposal with AI-generated description and parameters

mcpEndpoints.name: analyzeProposal
mcpEndpoints.description: Analyzes existing proposals for risks, benefits, and alignment

mcpEndpoints.name: castVote
mcpEndpoints.description: Casts a vote on a proposal after reputation and permission checks

securityNotes.keyManagement: Uses ERC-6551 token-bound account controlled via Account Abstraction (ERC-4337). No private keys stored in Goose runtime. All transactions signed via secure session keys or hardware modules.
